purpose: Deterministic child-side adapter boundary for captured Rich rendering; not a Harbor bundle and not a candidate CLI requirement.

transport.request: one JSON object per line on stdin
transport.response: one JSON object per line on stdout
transport.stderr: diagnostics only; never parsed as a result

options.color_system: null or explicit Rich color system

request.payload_policy: JSON-compatible scalars, arrays, and objects only; no callables, file handles, live tasks, clocks, or terminal handles

text_normalization.ansi: absent when color_system is null and force_terminal is false
forbidden_output: terminal cursor controls unless explicitly requested
